collection.description: After a storm destroys a home, a child asks whether the gods were angry.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: After a storm destroys a home, a child asks whether the gods were angry.

choices.label: Offer a spiritual interpretation without certainty
Admit nobody knows why this home was struck

a.name: Answer A
a.text: An elder describes prayer as a source of comfort, not proof of blame.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: A researcher describes wind and water while acknowledging the family's grief.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The child is allowed to feel angry and sad without being corrected.
